The increased capital requirements will involve more institutional investors alongside banks and a rise in asset-backed securities and other private credit markets for financing.

title: Walmart to expand drone delivery to hundreds of stores
summary: Walmart plans to significantly expand its drone delivery service, partnering with Wing to add drone delivery options to an additional 150 stores by 2026, aiming for a total of 270 U.S. locations by 2027. This expansion is projected to make drone delivery available to over 40 million Americans, enhancing convenience for customers to receive groceries and other items quickly. The service, which currently exists in parts of Texas and Atlanta, will extend to major cities like Los Angeles, St. Louis, Cincinnati, and Miami.

title: Wells Fargo Maintains Outperform on Microsoft (MSFT) Despite Lowered Target
summary: Wells Fargo maintained its "Outperform" rating on Microsoft (MSFT) but lowered its price target from $700 to $665, citing AI as the key driver for 2026. Jefferies also reiterated its "Buy" rating and $675 price target, emphasizing Microsoft's AI integration efforts. Both firms anticipate significant opportunities in the AI landscape, with Microsoft positioned as a top pick among mega-cap stocks.

title: Data center investments to hit $3 trillion over next five years, says Moody’s By Investing.com
summary: Moody's Ratings projects that approximately $3 trillion will be invested in data-center-related infrastructure over the next five years. This substantial capital influx is driven by the booming demand from artificial intelligence and cloud computing, with major tech companies leading the investment surge. The report also highlights the growing participation of institutional investors beyond banks and the increasing use of varied financing structures like asset-backed securities for data center projects.

title: Home Depot Goes All-In On Agentic AI With Google Cloud
summary: Home Depot announced an expanded strategic partnership with Google Cloud, focusing on agentic AI tools to provide real-time, expert guidance to customers. Leveraging Google Cloud's Gemini models, Home Depot aims to create a personalized "AI-first" experience through enhancements like the Magic Apron assistant and AI-powered product list builders. This initiative extends to Google Search's AI Mode and the Gemini app, ensuring home improvement expertise is accessible wherever customers are.

title: 3 Funds for 2026 and Beyond
summary: This article recommends three funds—Vanguard Dividend Growth (VDIGX), Artisan International Value (ARTKX), and Parnassus Core Equity (PRBLX)—as sensible long-term investments for 2026 and beyond. Author Russel Kinnel suggests these funds, despite subpar 2025 returns, offer defensive characteristics and quality holdings, making them suitable for navigating market uncertainties and potential economic shifts. He emphasizes a long-term investment horizon of a decade or more for these selections.

title: Why RBC Sees Opportunity in F5 Inc. (FFIV) After the Breach-Driven Pullback
summary: RBC Capital Markets upgraded F5 Inc. (FFIV) to Outperform, raising its price target to $325, after a security breach caused a substantial stock pullback. RBC believes the financial impact of the breach will be less than initially estimated and sees the stock's correction as a favorable entry point. The firm also identified several medium-term growth drivers for F5, including cloud repatriation, AI-driven workload monetization, and increased private data center investment.

title: Walmart expanding drone delivery to hundreds more stores, including in L.A.
summary: Walmart is significantly expanding its drone delivery service, partnering with Wing (an Alphabet company) to bring the service to 150 additional Walmart locations over the next year. This expansion will cover major metropolitan areas including Los Angeles, St. Louis, Cincinnati, and Miami, aiming to reach over 40 million Americans. The companies plan to establish a network of more than 270 drone delivery locations by 2027, with drones capable of carrying up to 5 pounds and delivering orders typically within 30 minutes.

title: Apple picks Google's Gemini to run AI-powered Siri coming this year
summary: Apple is partnering with Google to integrate Google's Gemini models and cloud technology into future Apple foundational AI models, including a significant upgrade to Siri expected later this year. This multi-year deal will see Apple leveraging Gemini for AI features, marking a major step for Apple in the AI space after largely staying out of the recent AI frenzy. The partnership also highlights Google's growing influence in AI and strengthens its existing financial ties with Apple.

title: Honeywell Taps Google Cloud To Reinvent In-Store Shopping
summary: Honeywell has partnered with Google Cloud and 66degrees to launch an AI-powered retail solution called the Smart Shopping Platform. This cloud-based platform, utilizing Google Gemini and Vertex AI, aims to enhance in-store shopping by providing personalized assistance, real-time product details, and dynamic recommendations. Despite this innovation, Honeywell recently revised its Q4 2025 and fiscal year 2025 financial guidance downwards due to segment restructuring and litigation expenses.

title: Zscaler Threat Report Highlights Android and IoT Security Risks
summary: Zscaler's ThreatLabz 2025 report reveals a significant increase in mobile and IoT malware, with over 40 million downloads of malicious Android apps. India, the US, and Canada are the primary targets for mobile attacks, while the US is the epicenter for IoT threats. The report emphasizes the critical need for Zero Trust approaches and AI-powered threat detection to combat these evolving risks.

title: OneAscent Financial Services LLC Sells 5,579 Shares of Alphabet Inc. $GOOG
summary: OneAscent Financial Services LLC significantly reduced its stake in Alphabet Inc. by 56.3% in Q3 2025, selling 5,579 shares and retaining 4,334 shares valued at $1.055 million. This divestment occurred amidst mixed sentiment for Alphabet, with strong Q3 earnings exceeding estimates and positive analyst ratings, contrasting with significant insider selling and regulatory pressures related to AI products. The company boasts a $3.97 trillion market cap and a P/E of 32.47, with analysts maintaining a consensus "Buy" rating and an average target price of $318.18.

title: Papa Johns chooses Google Cloud AI to overhaul digital ordering
summary: Papa Johns has partnered with Google Cloud to integrate its newly expanded AI solution, Food Ordering agent, across all digital ordering channels. This initiative aims to streamline the customer experience by providing a consistent voice and text AI ordering system across platforms like mobile apps, websites, and in-car systems. Papa Johns will be the first to implement this solution, which includes features like an Intelligent Deal Wizard and advanced group ordering capabilities, enhancing efficiency and customer interaction.

title: Soon, your next Papa Johns pizza order could be handled by AI
summary: Papa Johns has partnered with Google Cloud to transform its digital ordering experience using Google Cloud's Food Ordering agent, part of Gemini Enterprise for Customer Experience. This new omnichannel AI solution aims to improve customer service, speed, and accuracy for Papa Johns' 150 million+ customers worldwide. The new features include an Intelligent Deal Wizard, Advanced Voice & Group Ordering, and a no-tap reordering flow, with live demos at NRF 2026 and a nationwide rollout planned by the end of 2026.

title: Walmart se une à Alphabet para oferecer compras assistidas por IA na Gemini
summary: Walmart is partnering with Alphabet to integrate AI-enhanced shopping into Google's Gemini platform, allowing customers to purchase items directly through Gemini. This initiative is part of Walmart's broader strategy to apply AI across all its operations, from improving customer experience to supply chain management. The collaboration aims to move beyond traditional search bar shopping by anticipating customer needs and offering personalized product suggestions.

title: Walmart Expands AI Push With Google Gemini Shopping Integration
summary: Walmart has partnered with Google Gemini to integrate AI shopping tools, allowing customers to easily find and buy products from Walmart and Sam's Club. This collaboration, announced at the National Retail Federation's Big Show, will first launch in the U.S. and builds on Walmart's previous AI efforts with OpenAI's ChatGPT. The move underscores the growing influence of AI in retail, with companies like Microsoft also introducing agentic AI tools to automate retail tasks.

title: Google confirms multiyear AI deal to power Apple models, Siri
summary: Alphabet Inc.'s Google has confirmed a multiyear agreement with Apple Inc. to power the iPhone maker's artificial intelligence technology, including the Siri voice assistant. Google stated that Apple chose its AI technology for its capabilities, despite earlier reports of Apple planning to pay around $1 billion annually for such a deal. The partnership is expected to enhance a new version of Siri due this year, with Google assuring Apple's privacy standards will be maintained.

title: Annex Advisory Services LLC Cuts Holdings in Apple Inc. $AAPL
summary: Annex Advisory Services LLC decreased its stake in Apple Inc. by 2.9% in the third quarter, while several other institutional investors significantly increased their holdings. Two insiders, CFO Kevan Parekh and Chris Kondo, also sold a substantial number of shares, reducing their ownership. Despite these sales, analysts maintain a "Moderate Buy" consensus rating with an average target price of $284.07, and Apple recently announced a quarterly dividend.
